svg.title: With its steering trained into the weights, a language model agent sets its own goals along its current direction. A human who keeps up with the work chooses each next goal
svg.desc: Two full-width rows under the heading 'with the steering trained into the weights'. Both rows share the three-leap trunk from the start dot to the first ink goal ring, chosen by a dashed red aim arrow at the start, and both rows show twelve smooth leaps of a language model agent. At each step a jagged ball, pale at its center with its mass out along its spikes, shows the distribution of next steps with its spikes clustered along the smooth path, and no pick ring appears anywhere. Top row, 'the human falls behind': the soft red region of what the human understands covers only the first leap. Past the first goal ring, dashed teal aim arrows and teal goal rings labeled 'goals it sets itself' mark goals the agent sets straight ahead every three leaps along the old heading, and the twelfth leap runs straight out of the right edge of the frame. Bottom row, 'the human keeps up': the soft red region labeled 'what the human understands' covers the entire branching body of work. From the first goal ring two dashed red aim arrows choose an upper and a lower goal ring, from the upper goal another dashed red aim arrow chooses a fourth goal ring, and from the fourth goal a final dashed red aim arrow labeled 'the next goal' points onward.
svg.text: with the steering trained into the weights
